cases.input: A pinned policy expression is delivered and later acknowledged by the intended person.
cases.expect: Delivery and acknowledgement are separate immutable facts linked to the same communication event.

cases.input: The first delivery attempt fails and a second succeeds through another channel.
cases.expect: Both attempts remain recorded; event status derives from explicit outcomes without rewriting failure history.

cases.input: The policy is revised after acknowledgement.
cases.expect: The earlier event still resolves the exact prior expression; communicating the revision requires a new event.

cases.input: A system marks a control effective because the policy was acknowledged.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected; acknowledgement proves communication only.

cases.input: A communication to an organizational unit is treated as acknowledgement by every member.
cases.expect: Member acknowledgements remain unknown unless individually evidenced or governed delegation semantics exist.
